summary: Bitterroot NF lookout east of Darby, MT: first cabin about 1926, 1934 pole tower, present R-6 cab dated 1960 or 1961; NHLR-registered 2011; staffed summers per firelookout.com.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab, 15 by 15 feet, with catwalk on a 10-foot concrete base

staffing.status: staffed every summer, per firelookout.com; that page is undated and no later staffing source was found

Tom G. Lowman of Darby stationed there that summer

corrections.why: A Ravalli Republic report dated July 12, 1961 says the new tower had recently been erected and was finished by June 30. The register's 1960 date is earlier than that report describes. Medium confidence: the register may date the decision or the start of work.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says 1960 and firelookout.com says 1961. The July 1961 newspaper report describes the tower as just completed, so the story uses 1961 and notes the register's 1960.

notes_for_editor: Record check: height_m 3.0 is not carried. It matches the 10-foot concrete base, not a sourced overall tower height. Conflicts left open: the first cabin is dated 1926 by NHLR and firelookout.com, but a September 1924 newspaper item already has a man stationed there, so the station may be older. Present cab: NHLR 1960 vs newspaper 1961 (see corrections). No notable fire was found in the sources read. No access or visiting information was found, so the access key is omitted. Staffing evidence is an undated firelookout.com page; no 2020s staffing source was found. Reads: 5 pages (NHLR, firelookout.com, montanalookouts, two Bitterroot pages; the Darby district page and the fire management page did not mention the lookout) and 2 searches. The Forest Fire Lookout Association 2025 social post in search results (about the 1926 cabin) was not read.
